easyStandard.cultist: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
easyStandard.tablet: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.

hardExpert.skull: -2 (-4 instead if you are in a _Cave_ location).
hardExpert.cultist: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.
hardExpert.tablet: -3. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead. If you are not poisoned and you fail, put a set-aside 已中毒 weakness into play in your threat area.

pitfall.jumpTheGap: Test {agility} (3) to attempt to jump the gap. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
pitfall.shuffle: Shuffle Pitfall into the exploration deck. You cannot choose this option if Pitfall was drawn from the exploration deck.

descentToYoth.placeDoom: Place 1 doom on Descent to Yoth
descentToYoth.draw: Draw the top 2 cards of the encounter deck

mouthOfKnYanTheCavernsMaw.resign: "Let's make camp and solve this puzzle tomorrow."

featheredSerpent.evade: Check your supplies. If you have a mysterious scepter, you automatically evade the serpent and command it to deal its damage to another enemy at its location.

intro.title: 冒险V-A: 久远腹地，第一章
intro.intro1:
_Intro 1_: 自从你的队伍再次进入丛林探险以来，已经过了好几天，你们愈发频繁地遭遇危机，危险程度也与日俱增。努力保障此次旅程的食粮和补给品数量充足，这已经不容易，更别提还时常受到丛林住民的滋扰。万幸的是，你至今还没发现上次探险来袭的蛇族的踪迹，但你确定它们就在那里。它们在盯着你们，伺机而动。

在第六天的早晨，你找到了入口。这是一个巨大的洞穴入口，被树木、灌木丛和藤蔓遮挡着。你差点完全错过了这整个巨大的洞穴入口，尽管它是如此地庞大。洞穴入口周围的是六根石柱，每根石柱均覆盖着古怪的凹槽和闪着黯淡红光的雕文。或许你的向导之中有人会知道这是什么含义？

  • The investigators must decide (choose one):
    • *Let’s consult with Ichtaca*. Choose this option only if Ichtaca is in an investigator’s deck. Proceed to _Intro 2_.
    • *Let’s consult with Alejandro*. Choose this option only if Alejandro Vela is in an investigator’s deck. Proceed to _Intro 3_.
    • *Let’s consult the expedition journal*. Choose this option only if the Expedition Journal is in an investigator’s deck. Skip to _Intro 4_.
    • *I wish we knew more about this...* Skip to _Setup_.

label.else: *I wish we knew more about this...*

intro.intro2:
_Intro 2_: “那个入口有人把守，防止入侵者进入。”伊塔卡神秘地说道，合上双眼，仿佛用灵感来探索整个洞穴一般，“这些柱子就是钥匙。每根石柱都代表着一次对智能和意志的考验。”她向其中一根柱子踏近一步并伸出手掌触碰，柱身的光芒开始变亮。你发现这根柱子底下带有的凹槽形成一种图案，你曾在某个地方见过这图案。伊塔卡认为此地有人把守，如果你认同她的观点——必须得找到别的方法才能进去……

本场冒险开始时，将伊塔卡放置在场。 Skip to _Setup_.
intro.intro3:
_Intro 3_: 亚历山卓仔细地查看每根石柱。 “这些柱子的作用应该和门锁差不多。看这儿，看到了吗？凹槽没有刚好连成一线。”他转动其中一根石柱，随后你看见石柱向侧转动时显示的图案。“我敢打赌，要是没有把这些石柱正确排列就进洞的话，我们是走不远的。这只是我的直觉……但我认为我们应该更加仔细地检查这个区域，再进入洞穴。”你现在很了解亚历山卓，知道他的直觉往往是对的。

本场冒险开始时，将亚历山卓·维拉放置在场。 Skip to _Setup_.
intro.intro4:
_Intro 4_: 在上一次探险的日志内并不能找到所有的答案，但当你翻动书页的时候，一个熟悉的图样吸引了你的注意力——由此前丧生的探险队员洛伦佐所绘制的一个图样。这是从其中一处埃兹特里遗迹的石壁上细致摹画的雕纹。你从摹画下来的图样忠看到了许多图案和象形文本，与这些石柱上的一致。这部是个单纯的巧合。这些石柱无疑就是关键，能够令你找到恩凯之路……

本场冒险开始时，将探险日志放置在场。 Proceed to _Setup_.

setup.pathsKnownToYou: Check Campaign Log. *If 6 paths are known to you*, skip this scenario and proceed immediately to _Resolution 1_.
setup.gatherSets: Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: *Pillars of Judgment*, *Heart of the Elders*, *Rainforest*, *Serpents*, *Expedition*, and *Poison*. These sets are indicated by the following icons:
setup.placeLocations: Put the Mouth of K’n-yan into play, (*The Cavern’s Maw*) side faceup. Each investigator begins play at the Mouth of K’n-yan (*The Cavern’s Maw*).
setup.insightIntoHowToEnterKnYan: Check Campaign Log. Your journey beyond the boundary of time has granted you insight into how to enter K’n-yan. *For each path that is known to you*, place 1 resource on the Mouth of K’n-yan, as a pillar token.
setup.playedBefore: 如果你之前已进行过本场冒险，并且之前已到达场景2，将场景1a翻面并放置在昆扬之口上。
setup.explorationDeck: Create the exploration deck. This is done by taking the 6 single-sided _Jungle_ locations and shuffling them together, along with 1 copy each of the following encounter cards: Pitfall, Ants!, Lost in the Wilds, and Low on Supplies.
setup.chooseLocations: Randomly choose one of the following 3 _Ruins_ locations: Overgrown Ruins, Temple of the Fang, and Stone Altar. Shuffle the randomly chosen location into the exploration deck. Remove the other 2 from the game.
setup.mappedOutTheWayForward: Check Campaign Log. *If the investigators mapped out the way forward*, instead of shuffling the randomly chosen location into the exploration deck, put it into play.
setup.poisoned: 将不在调查员牌组中的所有中毒弱点卡放在一边。

label.replay: Replay _冒险V-A: 久远腹地，第一章_

noResolution.title: No Resolution
noResolution.body:
_If no resolution was reached (each investigator resigned or was defeated)_: 丛林实在过于危险，你无法继续探索。要是你再逗留下去，这些怪异石柱的所在将成为你的坟墓。你决定立即逃跑，回到数英里外一片熟悉的空地并修整队伍。你知道自己终究还是得回到石柱那去，搞懂那些图案才能开启前进的道路……但就现在而言，至少你保住了性命。

  • If there are more pillar tokens on the Mouth of K’n-yan than there were when the scenario began, in your Campaign Log, cross out how many *paths are known to you*. Then, record that *X paths are known to you*. X is the number of pillar tokens on the Mouth of K’n-yan.
  • The investigators must replay _冒险V-A: 久远腹地，第一章_. Reset the game to this scenario’s _Setup_. Do not record anything else in your Campaign Log except for any trauma suffered from your previous game. No experience points are earned from your previous game. Any player whose investigator was killed or driven insane must choose a new investigator to play, as normal.

resolution1.title: Resolution 1
resolution1.body:
_Resolution 1_: 你压抑着心中的恐惧，走进了洞穴……

  • In your Campaign Log, record that *the jungle watches*. Next to this, in parentheses, record the names of each card with 复仇X in the victory display. Do not record any tally marks under “Yig’s Fury.”
  • Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display.
  • 调查员不可以花费经验值，也不可以在冒险V-A和冒险V-B之间更改自己的牌组。 Proceed immediately to _冒险V–B: 久远腹地，第二章._

resolution2.title: Resolution 2
resolution2.body:
_Resolution 2_: You haven’t yet completed the puzzle of the six pillars that serve as the entrance to K’n-yan, but you don’t wish to tarry any further in this hostile jungle. You decide to enter the cavern anyway, hoping that whatever “wards” the pillars represent are nothing but ancient superstition…

  • You have trespassed in a hostile land. Place pillar tokens on the Mouth of K’n-yan until there are exactly 6 pillar tokens. Then, for every pillar token added in this way, record two tally marks under “Yig’s Fury” in your Campaign Log.
  • As you pass by the pillars, intense pain wrenches its way through your body, and you are afflicted with a terrible curse. Each investigator who is poisoned takes 1 mental trauma. Each investigator who is not poisoned adds a set‑aside 已中毒 weakness to their deck.
  • Proceed to _Resolution 1_.

setup.gatherSets: Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: *K’n-yan*, *Heart of the Elders*, *Agents of Yig*, *Yig’s Venom*, *Forgotten Ruins*, *Deadly Traps*, and *Poison*. These sets are indicated by the following icons:
setup.placeLocations: Put the Mouth of K’n-yan into play, (*The Depths Beneath*) side faceup. Each investigator begins play at the Mouth of K’n-yan (*The Depths Beneath*).
setup.theJungleWatches: Search the collection for each card listed in parentheses next to *“the jungle watches”* in your Campaign Log. Add those cards to the victory display.
setup.setAside: 将深入幽嘶地点放在一边，位于场外。
setup.explorationDeck: Create the exploration deck. This is done by taking the 5 remaining single-sided locations from the *K’n-yan* encounter set and shuffling them together, along with 1 copy each of the following encounter cards: Pitfall, No Turning Back, Deep Dark, and Final Mistake.
setup.poisoned: 将不在调查员牌组中的所有中毒弱点卡放在一边。

noResolution.title: No Resolution
noResolution.body:
_If no resolution was reached (each investigator was defeated):_ 你苏醒过来，发现自己处在一个更加寒冷、更深入的地方，躺在一块粗糙的石块上。你站起身来，环视周围环境，注意到一抹红光，它似乎是从你离开的洞穴发出的。你跟着光芒走了好几分钟，最后在其引领下来到一个亮堂的门廊，其中布满了石柱。在这间石室遥远的后方，有着一扇华丽而精致的大门，一块石盘被滚到了一旁，开启彼端如炼狱般的领域。

  • Check Campaign Log.
    • *If the investigators rescued Alejandro*, proceed to _Resolution 1_.
    • *If Alejandro is missing*, proceed to _Resolution 2_.

resolution1.title: Resolution 1
resolution1.body:
_Resolution 1_: “踏破铁鞋无觅处！幽嘶，万蛇之穴！从瓦卢西亚的灭顶之灾下逃离的、被诅咒的蛇族！”亚历山卓检查着大门，双眼流露出惊奇的神色，兴奋地举起双臂。你听不懂他在说些什么，但你开始有点担心。就在刚才，你身后传来急奔的脚步声，还有一阵咔㗳咔㗳的声音，仿佛你会突然被一支巨钳抓住。几个怪异的生物从你身后的黑暗中现身，你从未见过类似的生物：它们高逾十英呎，有着锥状的身体，躯干末尾还有着四根长短不一的奇异附肢。“你们来了。”亚历山卓平静地说道。其中一个生物以一种刻意的方式击打着自己的两个钳子，作为应答。“夺走他们的意识。”亚历山卓指挥这些生物，“我们已经不需要他们了。”这是你作为人类最后的记忆。

  • If the Harbinger of Valusia entered play during this scenario:
    • If it is in the victory display, cross out “*the Harbinger is still alive*” in your Campaign Log.
    • If it is still in play or is set aside, next to “*the Harbinger is still alive*” in your Campaign Log, record in parentheses how much damage is on the Harbinger of Valusia, replacing the number that was previously in parentheses.
  • For each vengeance point in the victory display, record one tally mark under “Yig’s Fury” in your Campaign Log.
  • Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display.

resolution2.title: Resolution 2
resolution2.body:
_Resolution 2_: 直到你进入洞穴的下一层之前，一阵咔㗳咔㗳的声音跟随着你，仿佛你会突然被一支巨钳抓住。几个怪异的生物从你身后的黑暗中现身，你从未见过类似的生物：它们高逾十英呎，有着锥状的身体，躯干末尾还有着四根长短不一的奇异附肢。当你看见这群生物的人类首领时，你十分震惊：那人正是亚历山卓·维拉。“夺走他们的意识。”亚历山卓指挥这些生物，“我们已经不需要他们了。”这是你作为人类最后的记忆。

  • If the Harbinger of Valusia entered play during this scenario:
    • If it is in the victory display, cross out “*the Harbinger is still alive*” in your Campaign Log.
    • If it is still in play or is set aside, next to “*the Harbinger is still alive*” in your Campaign Log, record in parentheses how much damage is on the Harbinger of Valusia, replacing the number that was previously in parentheses.
  • For each vengeance point in the victory display, record one tally mark under “Yig’s Fury” in your Campaign Log.
  • Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display.
